text: Olympus Mons is 21.9 kilometers tall. Olympus Mons is about 600 kilometers wide. Olympus Mons was discovered by Mariner 9 in 1971.
Olympus Mons is 25 kilometers tall according to older surveys. The Viking orbiters mapped Olympus Mons in 1976.
Olympus Mons is about 600 kilometers wide, roughly the size of Arizona.
Laser altimetry confirms that Olympus Mons is 21.9 kilometers tall.
